notes: INCOMPLETE LIST: the post's card section holds only shout-outs and commentary; the only cards are in the description field, which is cut off after 'STARSHIPS (11) Chimaera, Boba Fett In Slave I, IG-'. The archive copies (DeckTech live page and the Skilton archive) are cut off the same way. Only these 11 rows survive; the total is 11 as published, not 60.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 6 June 2001, before Coruscant, and no Coruscant-set card appears in what survives.

Starting cards as posted under STARTING STUFF (8): Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, Endor, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Endor: Bunker, Prepared Defenses, Something Special Planned For Them, Secret Plans, Imperial Decree; these count toward the total.
Posted 'Endor', 'Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)' and 'Endor: Bunker' dested the Dark Endor-set pages the Objective requires.
Posted 'IG-' is cut off mid-name (likely IG-88 In IG-2000 under STARSHIPS); shown as posted and counted.
The commentary also names Ominous Rumors, Imperial Command, Admiral Piett and Merrejk, and 'the maul's the vader's the mara's'; they are not in the surviving list and are not added.
